newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Berjaya proposes shares consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya proposes shares consolidation.

text.p: Property and securities investment firm Berjaya Holdings (HK) Ltd said it proposed to consolidate every 25 existing company shares of HK$0.20 each into one consolidated share of HK$5.00 each.

The proposal is conditional on stock exchange and shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting to be held on February 24. The share consolidation is expected to take effect from February 25, it said.
Berjaya said its trading lot will be reduced to 1,000 consolidated shares from 5,000 existing shares.

The company's executive director Tan Ee Ling said the proposal would enhance its company profile to institutional and international investors and shareholders could also benefit from the reduction of transaction costs.
Berjaya shares were untraded at HK$0.305 each in early trade. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
